copy.site_title: Nathan Puls | Simple Systems for Small Business
copy.hero_headline: There’s probably an easier way to do this.
copy.hero_subheadline: I help small business owners clean up repetitive admin work with simple systems that are easy to use.
copy.hero_note: No giant overhaul. Just practical cleanup for the work that keeps repeating.
copy.about_kicker: Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner, systems thinker, workflow untangler.
copy.about_body: Healthcare taught me to value clear communication, reliable processes, and tools that make the day easier. That’s the lens I bring to small business systems.
copy.problem_heading: If the little manual chores keep piling up, there’s probably an easier way.
copy.problem_body: Intake, follow-up, scheduling, emails, documents, reminders, reporting, handoffs. The usual stuff that eats the week.
copy.process_intro: Start with one workflow. Find the friction, simplify the steps, build the smallest useful fix.
copy.quote: Your workflow does not have to be perfect. It can be lighter.
copy.contact_heading: Want me to look at one messy process?
copy.contact_body: Send me the thing you keep doing manually. I’ll help you find the first fix.
copy.footer_text: Nathan Puls | Practical systems and automation help

faqs.question: Is this only AI automation?
faqs.answer: No. Sometimes AI is useful, sometimes a form, template, spreadsheet, or simple automation is enough. The goal is a better system, not forcing a trend into your business.

faqs.question: Do I need to know what I want automated?
faqs.answer: No. You can start with the annoying task, the messy handoff, or the thing you keep forgetting. I help translate that into a practical fix.

faqs.question: Do you work remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes. The service is built to work over the internet with forms, calls, shared docs, and walkthrough videos.

faqs.question: What kind of businesses is this for?
faqs.answer: Small service businesses, solo operators, consultants, clinicians, coaches, and teams that have outgrown doing everything manually.
